# Fastino Labs

> Build structured decisions with GLiDE, run schema-based extraction with GLiNER, and fine-tune specialized models with Fastino.

> ## Agent instructions
> Use https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json as the source of truth for customer-facing routes. GLiDE uses `POST /v1/systemone`; GLiNER and decoder inference use `POST /v1/chat/completions`; OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility use `POST /v1/responses` and `POST /v1/messages`. For very large GLiNER-2 inputs, submit `POST /v1/gliner-2/async` and poll `GET /v1/gliner-2/jobs/{job_id}`. Query `GET /v1/base-models?supports_inference=true` or `GET /v1/base-models?supports_training=true` for live capability. Do not infer undocumented routes. Read API keys from `FASTINO_API_KEY` and never embed credentials in code, logs, or reports.

## Agent resources

- [OpenAPI specification](https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json): Read the canonical customer-facing routes, authentication requirements, and request and response schemas.

- [Agent Skills catalog](https://docs.fastino.ai/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Discover installable skills for datasets, fine-tuning, GLiDE, GLiNER, and inference.

## Get started

- [Introduction](https://docs.fastino.ai/introduction.md): Learn how Fastino provides training and inference for specialized models.
- [Fastino quickstart](https://docs.fastino.ai/quickstart.md): Create a Fastino API key and run your first inference or training request.
- [Fastino GLiDE agent skill](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-agent-skill.md): Install GLiDE instructions for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex.
- [Example Use Cases](https://docs.fastino.ai/example-use-cases.md): Explore concrete GLiDE applications across agents, operations, safety, research, and product workflows.

## Decision Models

- [GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide.md): Understand when to use Fastino's decision model for classification, routing, and scoring.
- [GLiDE reference](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/decision-models.md): Read the request contract, state shapes, confidence formulas, and multi-question example.
- [Noul](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-noul.md): Ask a yes/no question and receive the probability that the answer is true.
- [Choice](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-choice.md): Select one caller-defined option and receive its probability distribution.
- [Score](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/glide-score.md): Select a level on an ordered rubric and receive a discrete score plus expected level.
- [Route requests with GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/guides/glide-routing.md): Build a request router, inspect route probabilities, and send uncertain decisions to a fallback.
- [Score on an ordered rubric with GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/guides/glide-scoring.md): Consume both discrete and continuous results from an ordered scoring rubric.
- [Rerank retrieved passages with GLiDE](https://docs.fastino.ai/guides/glide-reranking.md): Score query-to-passage relevance, filter weak matches, and rerank retrieved context.
- [GLiDE decision inference](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference/systemone.md): Choose Noul, Choice, or Score and follow the System One contract for calibrated decisions without generated text.

## Inference API

- [Inference overview](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference.md): Learn how to run inference with Fastino models through the GLiDE and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
- [GLiNER inference](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference/chat-completions.md): Choose the correct GLiNER endpoint for hosted, fine-tuned, synchronous native, or very large asynchronous workloads.
- [Inference history and feedback workflow](https://docs.fastino.ai/guides/inference-history-feedback.md): Store inference IDs, inspect historical results, and submit corrections through OpenAPI-backed endpoints.

## Training API

- [Fastino GLiNER agent skill](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-agent-skill.md): Install Fastino's hosted GLiNER skill for your coding agent.
- [Prepare and upload training datasets](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/datasets.md): Format JSONL, upload it through the dataset API, confirm processing, and pass the dataset to a training job.
- [Training API](https://docs.fastino.ai/training.md): Create and manage Fastino training jobs from submission through artifact delivery.
- [Create a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/create.md): Submit a new model training job.
- [List training jobs](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/list.md): List training jobs available to the current account.
- [Get a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/get.md): Retrieve the current state and metadata for one training job.
- [Update a training job's project](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/update-project.md): Assign a training job to a different project.
- [Rename a trained model](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/update-model-name.md): Change the model name associated with a training job.
- [Get training logs](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/logs.md): Read training output logs.
- [Get training-job billing](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/billing.md): Review billing information for a training job.
- [List training-job deployments](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/deployments.md): Read the deprecated compatibility operation for deployments associated with a training job.
- [Stop a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/stop.md): Request a graceful stop.
- [Terminate a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/terminate.md): Terminate a running job.
- [Synchronize a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/sync.md): Refresh training status from the provider.
- [Push a trained model to Hugging Face Hub](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/push-to-hub.md): Publish a completed training artifact.
- [List training checkpoints](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/checkpoints.md): List checkpoints produced by a training job.
- [Deploy a training checkpoint](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/deploy-checkpoint.md): Deploy a selected checkpoint for inference.
- [Download trained weights](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/download.md): Download a trained model artifact.
- [Delete a training job](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/training-jobs/delete.md): Delete a training job and its associated records.

## Models

- [GLiNER-2.5-Decide](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-2-5-decide.md): Use classification-tuned GLiNER for intent, routing, priority, moderation, and other operational labels.
- [GLiNER2.5](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner.md): Use multilingual, schema-driven information extraction.
- [Model catalog](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/models.md): Browse canonical model IDs, parameters, context windows, and per-model inference pricing.
- Query `GET https://api.fastino.ai/v1/base-models` for current model availability and pricing.

## API Reference

- [API Reference overview](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/overview.md): Start with authentication, model discovery, inference, and training.
- [Complete API inventory](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inventory.md): Read every method and path generated from the canonical OpenAPI specification.
- [Authentication](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/authentication.md): Authenticate native requests with `X-API-Key` and supported compatibility requests as documented.
- [API key management](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/api-keys.md): Create, list, rotate, and revoke Fastino API keys.
- [Errors](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/errors.md): Handle native, OpenAI-compatible, and Anthropic-compatible error shapes.
- [Rate limits](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/rate-limits.md): Review endpoint quotas and spending caps.
- [Prompt caching](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/prompt-caching.md): Configure and measure supported inference prompt caching.
- [GLiDE inference with `POST /v1/systemone`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/decision/systemone.md): Read the complete request and response contract, question schemas, limits, migration guidance, and worked examples.
- [`GET /v1/base-models`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/models/base-models.md): Query live model availability, inference support, and trainability.
- [`GET /v1/models`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/models/compatibility-models.md): List model IDs exposed by compatibility SDK surfaces.
- [GLiNER inference with `POST /v1/chat/completions`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/chat-completions.md): Read the complete request and response contract with entity, classification, constrained-classification, structure, relation, and combined-schema examples.
- [`POST /v1/responses`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/responses.md): Use the OpenAI Responses wire contract.
- [`POST /v1/messages`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/messages.md): Use the Anthropic Messages wire contract.
- [`GET /v1/inferences`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/history/list.md): List stored inference records.
- [`GET /v1/inferences/{inference_id}`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/history/get.md): Retrieve one stored inference record.
- [`POST /v1/inferences/{inference_id}/feedback`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/history/submit-feedback.md): Submit a verdict and optional correction.
- [`GET /v1/inferences/{inference_id}/feedback`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/history/get-feedback.md): Retrieve stored inference feedback.
- [`POST /v1/gliner-2`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/gliner-2.md): Run synchronous native GLiNER-2 inference.
- [`POST /v1/gliner-2/async`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/gliner-2-async.md): Submit very large GLiNER-2 inputs.
- [`GET /v1/gliner-2/jobs/{job_id}`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/gliner-2-job-status.md): Poll an asynchronous GLiNER-2 job.
- [`GET /v1/datasets`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/datasets/list.md): List available datasets.
- [`POST /v1/datasets/upload/url`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/datasets/upload-url.md): Create a presigned dataset upload URL.
- [`POST /v1/datasets/upload/process`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/datasets/process-upload.md): Process an uploaded dataset.
- [`GET /v1/datasets/{name}`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/datasets/versions.md): List processed dataset versions.
- [`DELETE /v1/datasets/{name}`](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/datasets/delete.md): Delete a dataset.

## SDK Integrations

- [OpenAI-compatible inference on Fastino API](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/openai-compatible.md): Run structured GLiNER extraction and classification through supported OpenAI SDK methods.
- [Anthropic-compatible POST /v1/messages on Fastino API](https://docs.fastino.ai/api-reference/inference/anthropic-compatible.md): Run structured GLiNER extraction and classification through the Anthropic SDK Messages API.
